```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(UpSetR)
```


```{r}
df <- read.csv("T:/Labs/Spakowicz/ppiio/data/derived/2025-02-17/CoRR_formatted.csv") %>%
  select( ppi, statin, h2b_iostart, steroid_iostart, abx_iostart, nsaid_iostart)
```

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  rename(
    `PPI` = ppi,
    `Statin` = statin, 
    `H2B` = h2b_iostart,
    `Steroids` = steroid_iostart,
    `ABx` = abx_iostart,
    `NSAIDs` = nsaid_iostart
  )
upset(df, sets = c("PPI", "Statin", "H2B", "Steroids", "ABx", "NSAIDs"), nintersects =20, main.bar.color = "slateblue2", matrix.color = "black", order.by = "freq")
```
